answer_prose: Being close to target pace at a checkpoint does not guarantee the target finish. Among runners close to sub-3 pace, 18.7% broke three hours at the 20 km check, versus 52.4% at 40 km.
detail_prose: Each checkpoint selects a different group of runners.
